chapter.title: General constraints
chapter.para: These requirements apply to the hypervisor as a whole.

section.para: The hypervisor shall provide the same behaviour on x86_64 and on arm64 for the same configuration, except where this document says otherwise.

formalpara.title: Traceability
formalpara.para: Not applicable: a constraint on the whole software, not implemented by one function.

section.para: The hypervisor shall run under QEMU with the software emulation of the processor (TCG), on x86_64 with SVM and nested paging and on arm64 with the virtualization extensions and a GICv2.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: QEMU is the target of the hypervisor.

section.para: The hypervisor shall consist only of code under the BSD-2-Clause or POK licence.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: The hypervisor stays BSD-only, so the code that it shares with the kernel has to be.

formalpara.title: Traceability
formalpara.para: Not applicable: a constraint on the whole software, not implemented by one function.

section.para: The hypervisor shall include nothing from the JetOS kernel.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: The hypervisor stays BSD-only, so the code that it shares with the kernel has to be.

formalpara.title: Traceability
formalpara.para: Not applicable: a constraint on the whole software, not implemented by one function.

section.para: The build of the hypervisor shall make, with its image, a script that runs it in QEMU with the right CPUs, memory and serial ports for the configuration.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: A configuration is run the way that it was meant.

formalpara.title: Traceability
formalpara.para: Not applicable: a constraint on the whole software, not implemented by one function.

section.para: The hypervisor shall be developed according to the MISRA C:2025 guidelines, with each deviation documented where it is made.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: The coding rules are a means to the safety of the code.

formalpara.title: Traceability
formalpara.para: Not applicable: a constraint on the whole software, not implemented by one function.
